notes.subject: ⟨en⟩
notes.rationale: pronoun supplied — Hebrew has suffix on טובו/יפיו but Tok Pisin needs separate word

notes.subject: his/their goodness
notes.rationale: טובו suffix read as God's (KJV) or the people's (JPS 'their') — context of the crowned flock in v.16 favors 'their'

notes.subject: ינובב
notes.rationale: from נוב 'to sprout/flourish' — agricultural verb applied to young men and maidens, produce and people grown together; picture flattened in 'make cheerful'

translation: Bihainen, olsem wanem gutpela samting bilong ⟨en⟩, na olsem wanem beauti bilong ⟨en⟩! Kaikai gaden i wokim ol yangpela man i kamap strong, na swit wain i wokim ol yangpela meri i kamap strong.
